durability.storage_resolution: explicit --ssd > HOLOINDEX_SSD_PATH > legacy HOLO_SSD_PATH > platform-safe absolute default
durability.partial_refresh_rule: only successfully refreshed collections receive the new repository SHA; untouched proof is preserved or marked UNVERIFIED
durability.maintenance_lease: <resolved_ssd_path>/indexes/holoindex_maintenance.lock; migrated mutation owners hold an exclusive cross-process lease from invalidation through final receipt; unleased legacy writers remain a Phase-1 limitation
durability.maintenance_source_gate: pre/post proof requires the same clean exact Git HEAD; Phase 1 additionally requires an exclusive repository-writer window because transient edit/revert cannot be mechanically excluded
durability.atomic_receipt_rule: publish IN_PROGRESS invalidation before collection access; publish PASS with fsync plus atomic replace only after the exact declared collection plan succeeds
durability.embedding_space_rule: each PASS collection binds sentence_transformers, its logical model, and a deterministic local-artifact fingerprint; the owner disables routing/cache and must match all seven fingerprints
durability.canonical_source_rule: CURRENT baseline proof requires each collection's stable source_scope_id, all eligible Git-tracked sources, a full raw-content manifest, and zero recorded source-read, cap, or Python-AST failures; no blanket all-parser guarantee is made
durability.restricted_worker_boundary: migrated RedDog operational consumers query an authenticated owner at literal 127.0.0.1; this supported API boundary is not an OS privilege boundary, and legacy foundups_mcp_bridge holo_tools remains outside the Phase-1 migration

invariants: search() always returns legacy keys code/wsps for compatibility
if embedding model is unavailable, retrieval falls back to lexical scan
default output path is tri-state: ERROR | FOUND | MISSING
symbol queries must attempt exact-fallback search to reduce NAVIGATION blind spots
CURRENT semantic freshness requires exact repository SHA, verified manifests, and matching embedding-space fingerprints for all baseline query collections
--index and --index-all select the same baseline: code, symbols, WSP, tests, skills, docs, and knowledge
query owners probe the maintenance lease before and after freshness and semantic retrieval
owner strict-semantic mode rejects collection, model, encoding, or query failures and never substitutes lexical or symbol fallback evidence
partial, raced, dirty-worktree, lexical, or receipt-write failures cannot publish CURRENT
